title: Bash Trap Command
title_vi: Bắt Tín Hiệu Hệ Thống Với Lệnh Trap
overview: Intercept Unix signals (SIGINT, SIGTERM, EXIT) to ensure clean script termination and cleanup.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice the reviewed shell concepts below. Instructions are independently written; functional requirements follow the linked public lesson.

sections.title: Implement a Basic Trap Command
sections.content:
Install cleanup_and_exit for SIGINT and SIGTERM around a running counter loop.

`~/project/trap_example.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
cleanup_and_exit() {
  echo "Signal received! Cleaning up and exiting..."
  exit 0
}
trap cleanup_and_exit SIGINT SIGTERM
echo "This script will run until you press Ctrl+C."
count=1
while true; do
  echo "Script is running... (iteration $count)"
  sleep 1
  ((count++))
done
```

Run:

```bash
bash ~/project/trap_example.sh 
```

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/trap_example.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['trap', 'SIGINT', 'SIGTERM', 'while']), 'Required concepts missing'
if False: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if True else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    import signal,time
    child=subprocess.Popen(['/bin/bash',str(p)],cwd=work,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
    try:
        time.sleep(0.25)
        child.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
        captured,_=child.communicate(timeout=3)
        assert child.returncode == 0
        assert 'Signal received!' in captured
    finally:
        if child.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
            child.wait()
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Make the Script Executable and Run It
sections.title_vi: Cấp quyền thực thi và chạy kịch bản
sections.content:
Make executable, run the counter, then press Ctrl+C to trigger graceful cleanup.

`~/project/trap_example.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
cleanup_and_exit() {
  echo "Signal received! Cleaning up and exiting..."
  exit 0
}
trap cleanup_and_exit SIGINT SIGTERM
echo "This script will run until you press Ctrl+C."
count=1
while true; do
  echo "Script is running... (iteration $count)"
  sleep 1
  ((count++))
done
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/trap_example.sh
~/project/trap_example.sh 
```

sections.content:
Expand cleanup_and_exit to report cleanup completion and graceful exit; test Ctrl+C again.

`~/project/trap_example.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
cleanup_and_exit() {
  echo "Signal received! Cleaning up..."
  echo "Performing cleanup tasks..."
  echo "Cleanup completed."
  echo "Exiting script gracefully."
  exit 0
}
trap cleanup_and_exit SIGINT SIGTERM
echo "This script will run until you press Ctrl+C."
count=1
while true; do
  echo "Script is running... (iteration $count)"
  sleep 1
  ((count++))
done
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/trap_example.sh
~/project/trap_example.sh 
```
